name: licenkit
description: LicenKit - Modern, self-hosted API-First licensing hub and key generator
author: LicenKit Contributors

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run test
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run deploy
